Questions

Which is cheaper, GPT-5.6 or GPT-6 Sol?

For a typical chatbot reply (1,500 input and 400 output tokens), GPT-5.6 costs $0.014 and GPT-6 Sol costs $0.0070 per request, so GPT-6 Sol is 50% cheaper. GPT-6 Sol is cheaper in every workload below.

How much do GPT-5.6 and GPT-6 Sol cost per million tokens?

GPT-5.6 costs $4 per 1M input tokens and $20 per 1M output tokens. GPT-6 Sol costs $2 input and $10 output. Prices checked 2026-10-01.

Do both models count the same text as the same number of tokens?

No. Each model family has its own tokenizer, so the same text can be a different number of tokens. The costs on this page already include that difference (estimated from GPT's tokenizer).
